meta.purpose: Parlay and prop-combo pricing must use measured dependence. This file is the register of which pairs we intend to measure, how, and - honestly - that not one of them has been measured in this repo yet.
meta.value_policy: measured_value is null for every pair. A null here is not an oversight and must never be replaced by a textbook number or a guess. It means: estimate it with the protocol below, or refuse to price the pair.

estimation_protocol.unit: paired legs settled on the same game
estimation_protocol.primary_statistic: phi coefficient on the 2x2 joint settlement table, plus the excess over the independence product: p(A and B) - p(A)p(B)
estimation_protocol.secondary_statistic: Spearman rank correlation on continuous outcomes (points, yards) where the pair is not binary
estimation_protocol.interval: nonparametric bootstrap, 10000 resamples, report the 95% interval; if the interval covers the independence value, the pair is labelled 'no detectable dependence' and is not priced on a correlation credit
estimation_protocol.stratification: estimate separately by leg family and by game-script proxy (pre-game favourite margin bucket), because a blowout induces dependence that a close game does not
estimation_protocol.pitfall: computing correlation on *win/loss of our bets* rather than on *event outcomes* mixes our pricing errors into the dependence estimate; measure on events, apply to prices

meta.sign_policy: expected_sign is a stated prior about direction, used only to sanity-check a measurement. It is not evidence of magnitude and is never used to price anything.

pairs.mechanism: A's points are an additive component of the game total
pairs.note: Exact correlation is bounded by the ratio of the two teams' scoring variances; both are computable from verified box scores - not computed in this build.

pairs.mechanism: both are monotone in the final margin
same margin, opposite sign; a push is the only deviation
pairs.use: This is the pair to use as a correctness test of the estimator: if the estimator does not return approximately -1, it is broken.

pairs.mechanism: shared play count; game script substitution
target share concentration; the same catch is in both legs
pairs.note: Highest-confidence positive pair in props, and the one books guard hardest with 'same player' rules - the pricing rule matters more than the correlation.
Often disallowed in the same parlay by operator rules; check rules before assuming the correlation is even usable (Q-MKT-04).

pairs.leg_b: Both teams to score / neither team under threshold

pairs.mechanism: wind suppresses efficiency but raises pass volume
pairs.note: A pair where the sign prior is genuinely uninformative; measuring it is the only way to know, and it is a good first experiment.

pairs.leg_a: Two different games' overs in a parlay
pairs.leg_b: Two different games' overs in a parlay
pairs.mechanism: no shared driver, unless both games are in the same weather system or the same late-start window
pairs.note: Cross-game 'independence' is the assumption parlays are priced on; it is nearly true, which is why the vig - not the correlation - is the cost of a cross-game parlay. Verify, do not assert.

pairs.leg_a: Availability-delta signal firing on Team A
pairs.leg_b: Availability-delta signal firing on Team B (same week)
pairs.mechanism: league-wide events (concussion list, flu/illness clusters, Thursday-short-week patterns) correlate injuries across clubs in the same week
pairs.note: This is the correlation that makes a same-week *portfolio* riskier than it looks. Visible in the Week 10 snapshot: 'Illness' appears as a listed cause on three different clubs in one slate (NE, HOU, DAL). Correlated availability is a portfolio effect, not a per-game one.

pairs.leg_a: Our model error on the spread
pairs.leg_b: Our model error on the total (same game)
pairs.expected_sign: positive if the shared driver is the availability adjustment
pairs.mechanism: both prices inherit the same availability score, so a scoring mistake is not diversified
pairs.note: Error correlation, not outcome correlation. Gate G-8 must consume this; it is the correlation most betting models never measure and the reason 'diversified' bets blow up together.

portfolio_notes: A parlay is only worth its correlation credit if the credit exceeds the extra vig. Compute both, publish both, and refuse the bet when the credit is unmeasured - which today is every bet in this catalogue.

Same-game legs share the referee, the weather, the game script and the availability report. The portfolio view must therefore cap exposure per *driver*, not per bet; S-01, S-02, S-03, S-07 and S-08 all read from the same injury file, so five strategies agreeing is one bet, not five.
Correlation between our strategies is more decision-relevant than correlation between two legs, because capital allocation follows strategy diversification.
